name: Wave Scan
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' three wavetable models in one slot, over its own 256-wave 8-bit bank: 20 named banks, a 16x16 interpolated map, and a curated line with a phase-domain crush.

controls.label: Model
controls.description: Selects the banks, the 16x16 map, or the curated line.

controls.label: Scan
controls.description: Position within the bank, along the map's X axis, or along the line.

controls.label: Shape
controls.description: Which of the 20 banks, the map's Y axis, or the line's four-zone crush.

controls.label: Snap
controls.description: Steps the scan between whole waves above noon, blurs it into their sum below; Braids exactly at the detent.

outputs.aux: Its complement: the adjacent wave, the opposite corner of the map cell, or the other end of the crush.
